name: C / C++
description: Memory safety, ABI, concurrency, and build-sensitive C/C++ changes.

lenses.hint: PRIMARY: UB, lifetime/use-after-free, integer overflow, wrong ownership (unique/shared), off-by-one buffers
PRIMARY: data races, lock order, atomics misuse, async callback lifetime
buffer overflows, format strings, unsafe casts, command injection, secret material in logs
ABI/header breaks, exported C API, protobuf/flatbuffer layout, version macros
unit/gtest for new branches; ASan/TSan-relevant cases when concurrency/memory surface changes
unbounded copies, hot-path allocations, cache unfriendly loops (only with evidence)
header pollution / macro footguns only if defect risk

extra_focus: Prefer findings tied to ownership/lifetime or concurrency with a concrete trigger.
Build system-only PRs (CMakeLists) may mark concurrency n/a; still check for insecure flags.
